_comment: Fill these in after the on-device capture in protocol/CAPTURE.md. metrox_rpc.py reads this file automatically. host/port may also be passed as CLI args (args win).
_framing_help: how a JSON request is delimited on the wire. Options: 'bare' (raw JSON, no delimiter), 'newline' (JSON + \n), 'length32' (4-byte little-endian length prefix), 'length16' (2-byte LE length prefix). Determine from the capture — see CAPTURE.md step 1.
_propertyTypes_help: integer propertyType IDs discovered on the device, e.g. { "exposure": 1512, "gain": 1513, "resolution": 1600, "triggerMode": 1700 }. Enumerate with getProperty/getPropertyRange or from the capture. Leave {} if unknown — getProperty/setProperty still work with a raw int.
_stream_help: how depth/RGB frames are delimited after startStream. Options: 'mjpg_eoi' (read until MJPG 0xFFD9 marker — default) or 'length_header' (4-byte LE length prefix). Determine from the capture.

usb._help: Filled from `lsusb` / `lsusb -v` (USB section of protocol/CAPTURE.md). vid/pid are 0xXXXX (the SDK finds the device via the USB\VID_xxxx&PID_xxxx&MI_xx instance id; MI = interface number). control_iface/data_iface are the MI numbers for the control-HID and data interfaces. If null, metrox_usb.py auto-picks interrupt/bulk endpoints. See PROTOCOL-USB.md.

depth._help: Filled from the device (getIntrinsics + Q-mat command) / a capture. See DEPTH-DECODE.md. Q = 4x4 back-projection matrix (row-major). cu/cv/cz normalize u/v/depth. win_* = depth validity window. near/far = featureReconstruct direction-normalize thresholds.
